records.sql: WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, q1_items, q2_items FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) AS total_decline, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff > 0) AS total_growth, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 3) AS t) AS top3_decline, ROUND((SELECT SUM(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 3) AS t) / (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) * 100, 2) AS top3_share_pct, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE cat IN ('informatica_acessorios', 'esporte_lazer')) AS top2_decline, ROUND((SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE cat IN ('informatica_acessorios', 'esporte_lazer')) / (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) * 100, 2) AS top2_share_pct, (SELECT SUM(q1_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'informatica_acessorios') AS ia_q1_items, (SELECT SUM(q2_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'informatica_acessorios') AS ia_q2_items, (SELECT SUM(q1_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'esporte_lazer') AS el_q1_items, (SELECT SUM(q2_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'esporte_lazer') AS el_q2_items LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS common_categories, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff > 0) AS growing_categories, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff = 0) AS flat_categories, SUM(diff) AS total_diff FROM cmp LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders_cnt FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN orders_cnt END) AS q1_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN orders_cnt END) AS q2_orders FROM q GROUP BY cat) SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, ROUND((q2_gmv - q1_gmv) / q1_gmv * 100, 2) AS pct_change, q1_items, q2_items, q2_items - q1_items AS items_diff, q1_orders, q2_orders, q2_orders - q1_orders AS orders_diff, ROUND(q1_gmv / q1_items, 2) AS q1_avg_price, ROUND(q2_gmv / q2_items, 2) AS q2_avg_price FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv < q1_gmv ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, q1_items, q2_items FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) AS total_decline, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff > 0) AS total_growth, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 3) AS t) AS top3_decline, ROUND((SELECT SUM(diff) FROM (SELECT diff FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 3) AS t) / (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) * 100, 2) AS top3_share_pct, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE cat IN ('informatica_acessorios', 'esporte_lazer')) AS top2_decline, ROUND((SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE cat IN ('informatica_acessorios', 'esporte_lazer')) / (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) * 100, 2) AS top2_share_pct, (SELECT SUM(q1_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'informatica_acessorios') AS ia_q1_items, (SELECT SUM(q2_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'informatica_acessorios') AS ia_q2_items, (SELECT SUM(q1_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'esporte_lazer') AS el_q1_items, (SELECT SUM(q2_items) FROM cmp WHERE cat = 'esporte_lazer') AS el_q2_items LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv FROM q GROUP BY cat) SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, ROUND((q2_gmv - q1_gmv) / q1_gmv * 100, 2) AS pct_change FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv < q1_gmv ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 10

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, q1_items, q2_items FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff < 0 AND q2_items < q1_items) AS decline_volume_driven, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff < 0 AND q2_items >= q1_items) AS decline_price_driven, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff < 0 AND q2_gmv / q2_items < q1_gmv / q1_items) AS decline_avg_price_down, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff < 0 AND q2_gmv / q2_items >= q1_gmv / q1_items) AS decline_avg_price_up FROM cmp LIMIT 1000

SELECT CASE WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN '2018Q1' WHEN order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN '2018Q2' END AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') AS canceled, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS cancel_pct FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, oi.price AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), agg AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q2_gmv FROM q GROUP BY cat) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv - q1_gmv < 0) AS declining, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv - q1_gmv > 0) AS growing, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv = q1_gmv) AS flat, SUM(CASE WHEN q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv - q1_gmv < 0 THEN q2_gmv - q1_gmv ELSE 0 END) AS total_decline_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv - q1_gmv > 0 THEN q2_gmv - q1_gmv ELSE 0 END) AS total_growth_amount FROM agg LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, oi.price AS gmv FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL), agg AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q2_gmv FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff FROM agg WHERE q1_gmv > 0 AND q2_gmv > 0) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories, COUNT(*) AS compared_categories, (SELECT cat FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_category, (SELECT diff FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1) AS largest_drop_amount FROM cmp LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, oi.price AS gmv, oi.order_id, oi.seller_id FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL) SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) AS diff, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN order_id END) AS q1_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN order_id END) AS q2_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN seller_id END) AS q1_sellers, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN seller_id END) AS q2_sellers FROM q GROUP BY cat HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q1' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN qtr = 'Q2' THEN gmv ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 10

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, oi.price AS gmv, oi.order_id, oi.order_item_id FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name = 'informatica_acessorios') SELECT qtr, SUM(gmv) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(gmv) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS gmv_per_order, ROUND(CAST(AVG(gmv) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_item_price FROM q GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS qtr, oi.price AS gmv, oi.order_id FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01') SELECT qtr, SUM(gmv) AS total_gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM q GROUP BY qtr ORDER BY qtr LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_records, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c USING (customer_id) WHERE c.customer_state = 'ZZ' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zz_rows FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'ZZ' LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' END AS quarter, i.price FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'), agg AS (SELECT quarter, SUM(price) AS gmv FROM q GROUP BY quarter) SELECT MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q1') AS q1_gmv, MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q2') AS q2_gmv, ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q2') - MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q1')) / NULLIF(MAX(gmv) FILTER(WHERE quarter = 'Q1'), 0), 2) AS change_pct FROM agg LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv_2027, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_2027 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2027-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2028-01-01' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts FROM orders AS o LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv_all, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_all, MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01' LIMIT 1000

SELECT SUM(i.price) AS gmv, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2026-01-01' LIMIT 1000
SELECT MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS min_ts, MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts, COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders AS o LIMIT 1000

WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_unique_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS cu USING (customer_id) WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY cu.customer_unique_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS buyers, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n >= 2) AS repeat_buyers, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE n >= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS repeat_pct FROM c LIMIT 1000

WITH base AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c USING (customer_id) WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND c.customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ')), buyers AS (SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers FROM base GROUP BY customer_state), gmv AS (SELECT b.customer_state, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM base AS b JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT b.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY b.customer_state), j AS (SELECT bu.customer_state, bu.buyers, g.gmv, g.gmv / bu.buyers AS gmv_per_buyer FROM buyers AS bu JOIN gmv AS g USING (customer_state)) SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN buyers END) AS sp_buyers, MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN buyers END) AS rj_buyers, MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN gmv END) AS sp_gmv, MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN gmv END) AS rj_gmv, MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN buyers END) - MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN buyers END) AS buyers_diff_sp_minus_rj, MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN gmv END) - MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN gmv END) AS gmv_diff_sp_minus_rj, ROUND(CAST(MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN buyers END) AS DECIMAL) / MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN buyers END), 4) AS buyers_ratio_sp_over_rj, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN gmv END) / MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN gmv END), 4) AS gmv_ratio_sp_over_rj, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN gmv_per_buyer END), 2) AS sp_gmv_per_buyer, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN gmv_per_buyer END), 2) AS rj_gmv_per_buyer, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'SP' THEN gmv_per_buyer END) - MAX(CASE WHEN customer_state = 'RJ' THEN gmv_per_buyer END), 2) AS gmv_per_buyer_diff_sp_minus_rj FROM j LIMIT 1000

WITH base AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.order_status, c.customer_unique_id, c.customer_state FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c USING (customer_id) WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND c.customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ')), buyers AS (SELECT customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS buyers FROM base GROUP BY customer_state), gmv AS (SELECT b.customer_state, SUM(i.price) AS gmv FROM base AS b JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) WHERE NOT b.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY b.customer_state) SELECT bu.customer_state, bu.buyers, g.gmv FROM buyers AS bu JOIN gmv AS g USING (customer_state) ORDER BY bu.customer_state LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS quarter, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmp) AS compared_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) AS declining_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmp WHERE diff > 0) AS rising_categories, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmp WHERE diff = 0) AS flat_categories, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) AS total_decline_amount, (SELECT SUM(q1_gmv) FROM cmp) AS q1_total_gmv, (SELECT SUM(q2_gmv) FROM cmp) AS q2_total_gmv, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp) AS net_change FROM (SELECT 1) AS x LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS quarter, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, q1_items, q2_items, q2_items - q1_items AS items_diff, (q2_gmv - q1_gmv) - (q2_items - q1_items) * (q1_gmv / q1_items) AS volume_effect, (q2_items - q1_items) * (q1_gmv / q1_items) AS volume_effect_alt, q2_items * ((q2_gmv / q2_items) - (q1_gmv / q1_items)) AS price_effect FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, diff, q1_items, q2_items, items_diff, ROUND(volume_effect_alt, 2) AS volume_effect, ROUND(price_effect, 2) AS price_effect, ROUND(100.0 * diff / q1_gmv, 2) AS pct_change FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 5

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS quarter, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS products, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS sellers, SUM(oi.price) / COUNT(*) AS avg_item_price FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN orders END) AS q1_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN orders END) AS q2_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN products END) AS q1_products, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN products END) AS q2_products, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN sellers END) AS q1_sellers, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN sellers END) AS q2_sellers, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN avg_item_price * items END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN items END), 0) AS q1_avg_price, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN avg_item_price * items END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN items END), 0) AS q2_avg_price FROM q GROUP BY cat) SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, q1_items, q2_items, q1_orders, q2_orders, q1_products, q2_products, q1_sellers, q2_sellers, q1_avg_price, q2_avg_price FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q2_gmv - q1_gmv ASC LIMIT 5

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS quarter, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv FROM q GROUP BY cat), cmp AS (SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL) SELECT (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0) AS total_decline, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff > 0) AS total_increase, (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 AND cat IN ('informatica_acessorios', 'esporte_lazer')) AS top2_decline, (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(diff) / (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0), 2) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 AND cat IN ('informatica_acessorios', 'esporte_lazer')) AS top2_share_of_decline_pct, (SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(diff) / (SELECT SUM(diff) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0), 2) FROM cmp WHERE diff < 0 AND cat = 'informatica_acessorios') AS top1_share_of_decline_pct FROM (SELECT 1) AS x LIMIT 1000

WITH q AS (SELECT p.product_category_name AS cat, CASE WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' THEN 'Q2' WHEN o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' THEN 'Q1' END AS quarter, SUM(oi.price) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders, COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS sellers FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE NOT o.order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' AND p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND p.product_category_name <> '' GROUP BY 1, 2), piv AS (SELECT cat, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN gmv END) AS q1_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN gmv END) AS q2_gmv, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN items END) AS q1_items, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN items END) AS q2_items, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN orders END) AS q1_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN orders END) AS q2_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q1' THEN sellers END) AS q1_sellers, SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q2' THEN sellers END) AS q2_sellers FROM q GROUP BY cat) SELECT cat, q1_gmv, q2_gmv, q2_gmv - q1_gmv AS diff, q1_items, q2_items, q1_orders, q2_orders, q1_sellers, q2_sellers FROM piv WHERE q1_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv IS NOT NULL AND q2_gmv - q1_gmv < 0 ORDER BY diff ASC LIMIT 1000

SELECT COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '(null)') AS category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(oi.price) AS sales FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' AND (p.product_category_name ILIKE '%quantum%' OR p.product_category_name ILIKE '%teleport%') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_count, COUNT(DISTINCT product_category_name) AS distinct_categories FROM products LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE product_category_name = 'quantum_teleportation' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COALESCE(p.product_category_name, '(null)') AS category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, SUM(oi.price) AS sales FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY sales DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS translation_rows FROM product_category_name_translation LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products WHERE product_category_name ILIKE '%quantum%' OR product_category_name ILIKE '%teleport%' LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS translation_count FROM product_category_name_translation WHERE product_category_name = 'quantum_teleportation' OR product_category_name_english = 'quantum_teleportation' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS translation_count FROM product_category_name_translation WHERE product_category_name ILIKE '%quantum%' OR product_category_name_english ILIKE '%quantum%' OR product_category_name ILIKE '%teleport%' OR product_category_name_english ILIKE '%teleport%' LIMIT 1000

WITH q2 AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'), per_order AS (SELECT r.order_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN q2 AS q ON q.order_id = r.order_id GROUP BY r.order_id) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE n > 1) AS orders_with_multiple_reviews, (SELECT MAX(n) FROM per_order) AS max_reviews_per_order, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE n = 2) AS orders_with_2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_order WHERE n = 3) AS orders_with_3 LIMIT 1000

WITH q2 AS (SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'), agg AS (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM q2) AS orders, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN q2 AS q ON q.order_id = r.order_id) AS reviewed_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN q2 AS q ON q.order_id = r.order_id) AS review_rows) SELECT orders, reviewed_orders, review_rows, review_rows - reviewed_orders AS rows_minus_orders, ROUND(100.0 * review_rows / NULLIF(reviewed_orders, 0), 2) AS pct_overcount, ROUND(100.0 * reviewed_orders / NULLIF(orders, 0), 2) AS review_rate_pct FROM agg LIMIT 1000

WITH base AS (SELECT i.price, t.product_category_name_english AS eng FROM order_items AS i JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t USING (product_category_name) WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01') SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_items, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NULL) AS untranslated_items, SUM(price) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NULL) AS untranslated_price, SUM(price) AS all_price, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NOT NULL) AS translated_items, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NULL) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 4) AS untranslated_item_share_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(price) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NULL) / SUM(price), 4) AS untranslated_price_share_pct, COUNT(*) - COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NOT NULL) AS items_lost_by_inner_join, SUM(price) - SUM(price) FILTER(WHERE eng IS NOT NULL) AS price_lost_by_inner_join FROM base LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inner_join_items, SUM(i.price) AS inner_join_price FROM order_items AS i JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t USING (product_category_name) WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS all_items, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE t.product_category_name_english IS NULL) AS untranslated_items, SUM(i.price) FILTER(WHERE t.product_category_name_english IS NULL) AS untranslated_price, SUM(i.price) AS all_price, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.product_category_name IS NULL) AS null_category_items, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL AND t.product_category_name_english IS NULL) AS nonnull_untranslated_items FROM order_items AS i JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS t USING (product_category_name) WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 1000

SELECT 'Q1' AS quarter, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') AS canceled, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS cancel_pct, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'Q2', COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled'), 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 1000
SELECT order_status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' GROUP BY order_status ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT 'Q1' AS quarter, COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') AS canceled, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS cancel_pct, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'Q2', COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled'), 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01' LIMIT 1000
